tagline: Read your voice notes when you can't listen.
howToStep1: In WhatsApp, long-press a voice note.
howToStep3: Read it in Arabic script or Arabizi.
privacy: Your audio is deleted right after transcription. Transcripts stay on your phone.
transcriptMissing: This transcript is no longer available. Pick the voice note again.
errorOffline: No internet connection. Check it and try again.
errorBusy: The server is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
errorTooLong: This note is too long: 5 minutes maximum.
errorTooLarge: This file is too big: 25 MB maximum.
errorFormat: This file isn't a voice note we can read.
errorRateLimited: You've reached today's limit. Try again tomorrow.
